labels.label: btzcor:common_reg

hypotheses.note: M, N connected, inherited from GX.BTZCommonReg.common_reg (OQ-150 (b), DEC-125 (e)); also needed for e0RegMFlat to be a flat spacetime

isometry reading of OQ-152 (a): f : e0RegMFlat M → e0RegMFlat N with Causal.Flat.IsIsometricEmbedding 2 f and Surjective f. common_reg_either takes the disjunction of this and the E0-morphism reading of common_reg
F : M ≃ₜ N, E0-morphism both ways, F ∘ val = val ∘ regMap f (extends the isometry)

questions: OQ-152 (a), l.1275: « reg(M) ≃ reg(N) » is now covered in both readings — a bijective E0-morphism of the regular open sets (GX.BTZCommonReg.common_reg) and a surjective isometric embedding of the flat spacetimes e0RegMFlat (GX.BTZCommonRegIso.common_reg_of_isometry); common_reg_either takes either. Not decided here; whichever the author rules, the row's mark then depends only on T-btz-scope and the added connectedness.

kb_proposals: The E0-structure of FlatE0 (e0RegMFlat N) is that of the open set E0LM.e0RegM N: the identity is an E0-morphism both ways (GX.BTZCommonRegIso.isE0Mor_flatE0Val, isE0Mor_toFlatE0, GXScaffold.BTZ.CommonRegIso), each through E0AbsMax.isLocalStructomorphWithinAt_of_eventually with g = 1 and the charts e0Inl.symm, regAtlasChart; work pointwise with OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeRestr_symm_apply / subtypeRestr_target_subset on regChartM, never by an equation of charts (the chart of FlatE0 and (chartAt E0Y y).trans ρ live over types that differ at instance transparency, and trans_assoc is not rfl).

An isometric embedding e0RegMFlat M → e0RegMFlat N is an E0-morphism of the regular open sets (GX.BTZCommonRegIso.isE0Mor_of_isIsometricEmbedding): E0AbsMax.isE0Mor_regExt, composed with isE0Mor_flatE0Val and isE0Mor_val, then isE0Mor_corestrict_iff.
notes: Sorry-free, no added axiom; `lake build GXScaffold.BTZ.CommonRegIso` succeeded with no rebuild of GX.* or mathlib. The new module imports GXScaffold.BTZ.CommonReg (read-only, unchanged) and is listed in scaffold/GXScaffold.lean right after it (one line). The converse direction of the bridge (E0-morphism ⇒ isometry) is not built here (T-btz-cauchy-easy). The module docstring at the end of scaffold/GXScaffold.lean lists the BTZ modules and does not yet name CommonRegIso; it was not edited (only the import line was in dispatch).
